text:
maria: Heads-up — planning to enable safepatch-v1 in the model catalog during tomorrow's change window 08:00-10:00 UTC. Need to lock fallback ordering, canary percentages, and pin/rollback triggers. @dave @sylvia can you take a look?
dave: Ack. Quick Q — are we targeting hosted-only or ded/private too?
maria: Hosted + Dedicated. For Dedicated we'll only flip if capacity checks pass; otherwise fallback to baseline-v2.
sylvia: I can draft the rollout plan. Proposed canary: 5% for 30m, then 25% for 60m, then 100% if no regressions. Fallback order: [safepatch-v1, safepatch-quant, baseline-v2].
leo: Ops note — schedule double-check on GPU pool capacity. If we exceed slot utilization > 85% for 10m, treat as capacity incident and rollback. I'll add a temporary scaling policy for the window.
deploybot: deploybot: queued enable job safepatch-v1 -> will run when triggered. CLI preview:
```
# preview
catalog.enable --model safepatch-v1 --mode staged --canary 5 --stabilize 30m --next 25 --rollout 100
catalog.fallback --model safepatch-v1 --order safepatch-v1,safepatch-quant,baseline-v2
```
sylvia: Rollback criteria (proposed):
- error_rate >= 0.5% sustained for 5m OR
- inference_p95 latency > 200ms for 5m OR
- quality regression on smoke prompts (auto-eval fails)
If triggered, immediate pin to baseline-v2 and full drain of safepatch-v1.
dave: Add a soft-rollback trigger for noise: if small regressions for 2 of 3 eval suites but infra stable, hold at 25% and notify for manual review.
oncall: I'll be watching the incident dashboard and will escalate if alerts fire. Please set metric hooks: p95_latency, errors_1m, eval_regressions.
maria: Sylvia — can you add a short release note and the rollout blurb? Also leave a pinned rollback command.
sylvia: On it. Release note draft: "safepatch-v1: improved instruction-following and memory usage; expect slight latency bump in edge cases. Rolling staged enable with fallback to baseline-v2."
sylvia: Pinned rollback snippet (for ops):
```
# emergency rollback
catalog.pin --model baseline-v2 --reason "safepatch rollback" --force
catalog.disable --model safepatch-v1 --drain 0
```
maria: Perfect. I'll trigger deploybot at start of window and run the 5% canary. @leo please confirm scaling tweak is applied 15m before.
leo: Will do. I'll also pre-warm cache and KV for safepatch to reduce early p95 spikes.
deploybot: deploybot: scheduled job safepatch-v1 enable at 08:00 UTC tomorrow. Status: scheduled.
maria: Thank you — locking plan. If anyone sees anything missing speak now, otherwise I will post the final checklist and release notes to the release channel and tag oncall.
dave: LGTM :thumbsup:
oncall: noted. I'll keep a brief play-by-play in this thread during the window.
maria: Appreciated.
